description: Lossless editing JSON contract for com3d2.preset.

BodyProperty.description: The nested CM3D2_MAID_BODY block used for body-scope presets.
BodyProperty.title: Body data
BodyProperty.x-meido-edit-guidance: Do not add body data to a wear-only preset unless the target loader expects it.
BodyProperty.x-meido-game-usage: Maid restores body-specific state when PresetType includes body data.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The preset writer emits CM3D2_PRESET, a type marker, thumbnail, property list, color data, and optional body data; the loader restores those blocks and applies them to a maid.

MultiColor.title: Part color data
MultiColor.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep part ordering and use ranges accepted by the target editor.
MultiColor.x-meido-game-usage: Maid applies them to part color and gradation state when the preset scope includes colors.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The preset writer emits CM3D2_PRESET, a type marker, thumbnail, property list, color data, and optional body data; the loader restores those blocks and applies them to a maid.

PresetPropertyList.description: The nested CM3D2_MPROP_LIST block containing part and attachment properties.
PresetPropertyList.title: Maid property list
PresetPropertyList.x-meido-edit-guidance: Edit only known properties and preserve map/order metadata and unknown nested records.
PresetPropertyList.x-meido-game-usage: CharacterMgr and Maid deserialize these values and apply menu parts, attachments, material properties, and bone lengths.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The preset writer emits CM3D2_PRESET, a type marker, thumbnail, property list, color data, and optional body data; the loader restores those blocks and applies them to a maid.

PresetType.description: The enum selecting wear, body, or all character data.
PresetType.title: Preset scope
PresetType.x-meido-edit-guidance: Use the target game's values 0=wear, 1=body, 2=all and keep matching blocks populated.
PresetType.x-meido-game-usage: PresetSet applies the corresponding property, color, and body blocks to the selected maid.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The preset writer emits CM3D2_PRESET, a type marker, thumbnail, property list, color data, and optional body data; the loader restores those blocks and applies them to a maid.

ThumbData.description: PNG thumbnail bytes stored with the preset.
ThumbData.title: Preset thumbnail
ThumbData.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep valid PNG bytes or preserve the original thumbnail when editing other fields.
ThumbData.x-meido-game-usage: The preset browser decodes them for its preview; they do not change character state.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: The preset writer emits CM3D2_PRESET, a type marker, thumbnail, property list, color data, and optional body data; the loader restores those blocks and applies them to a maid.

Version.description: The version controlling the nested Maid property layouts.
Version.title: Preset version
Version.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve it and do not mix blocks from another preset generation.
Version.x-meido-game-usage: CharacterMgr passes it to the nested deserializers and uses it when deciding which blocks are present.
